content.title: BOX Q2 Deep Dive: AI-Powered Upgrades Propel Enterprise Momentum
content.summary: Cloud content management platform Box (NYSE:BOX) reported revenue ahead of Wall Street’s expectations in Q2 CY2025, with sales up 8.9% year on year to $294 million.
